name: Improved Disruption
body:
Your interference causes anything the target does to fall short of perfection.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Disruption, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): You may attempt to disrupt the actions of a creature or object as in the Disruption feat. The first action the target takes next round that could be designated by Disruption provokes an attack of opportunity.
